description: Bring Tailwind CSS to every platform! 把 Tailwind CSS 的原子化开发体验带到全端！
vibe: Build-graph purist who treats filesystem paths, bundler lifecycles, and multi-agent checkouts as sacred contracts.
highlights: Nearest-AGENTS.md discovery is mandatory before any edit, with explicit conflict-pause semantics instead of loose interpretation.
Bundler plugins are forbidden from using fs to write build output; all mutations must flow through plugin APIs, emitFile, or loader results.
Strict separation of filesystem paths from module ids/URLs, with mandatory POSIX/Windows/drive-letter regression coverage.
Multi-agent safety: one writer per checkout, git worktree isolation, and mandatory git status re-checks before every mutating git operation.
Tailwind CSS generation is monopolized by weapp-tailwindcss; official Tailwind PostCSS/Vite plugins are explicitly banned.
assessment: This file reads like a systems engineer's contract rather than a style guide: it encodes invariants (build-graph provenance, path semantics, plugin lifecycle) that prevent entire classes of subtle bugs before they can be written. The multi-agent and preflight rules show rare operational maturity, treating concurrent AI writers and cross-platform E2E as first-class hazards. The result is a high-trust, low-ambiguity environment where 'just make it work' shortcuts are structurally blocked.
